The baseline install was therefore to run as `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, recorded as a labeled deviation, with a truthful note on whether the production build depends on any postinstall side effect.

The purpose-bound consent covers acquisition for corpus admission; running a dependency install for a candidate that did not pass admission would spend it outside its purpose. The deviation stays pre-ruled and unexercised, available to whichever unit resumes this candidate if the PM amends the licence policy.
